principle.es: Capas verticales funcionales: nunca construir los 30 módulos a la vez.
principle.en: Functional vertical slices: never build all 30 modules at once.
principle.pt: Camadas verticais funcionais: nunca construir os 30 módulos de uma vez.

phases.name: Bootstrap
phases.exit_criteria: genesis init produces manifest/state/checkpoints and every operation emits an event.

phases.name: Capture
phases.exit_criteria: A conversation transcript can be ingested into data/raw and parsed into typed message entities.

phases.name: Knowledge Engine
phases.exit_criteria: Processed entities live in SQLite+FTS5, are searchable and feed the knowledge graph and session context.

phases.name: Documentation Engine
phases.exit_criteria: Every session produces human-readable documentation automatically, without being asked.

phases.name: Web App
phases.exit_criteria: Dashboard/Sessions/Knowledge/Timeline navigable in Next.js AND in the zero-dep offline console.

phases.name: Agent
phases.exit_criteria: genesis resume observes, contextualizes, plans, executes, verifies and recovers without human restating context.

phases.name: Education
phases.exit_criteria: A completed build is converted into a lesson with exercise and real solution code.

phases.name: Autonomous Evolution
phases.exit_criteria: An error produces a lesson and a new policy rule that prevents the same failure next time.

layer_rule.es: El agente nunca salta arbitrariamente entre capas 0-10.
layer_rule.en: The agent never jumps arbitrarily between layers 0-10.
layer_rule.pt: O agente nunca salta arbitratoriamente entre as camadas 0-10.
